subject: selectInput not recognizing select option for dplyr grouped data frame

messages.author: c620544f71224624
messages.subject: selectInput not recognizing select option for dplyr grouped data frame
parts:
I have a grouped dplyr data frame, and the the "selected" option is not working in select input. Specifically, the selected input does not automatically appear as the default when the app is rendered.

# Does not show selected values
selectInput("origin", label = "Flight origin", pred_data$origin, selected =  "JFK")

My workaround was to create a unique value list and then pass that list into selectInput. This works fine.

# Shows selected values
carrier_origin <- ungroup(pred_data) %>% distinct(origin) %>% .[['origin']]
selectInput("origin", label = "Flight origin", carrier_origin, selected =  "JFK")
